title: The Tiger and the Red Bean Porridge
moral: When little friends work together, they can even send a great big tiger away.
notes: 영어 읽어 주기 대본(docs/READ_MODE.md). text 는 한국어 줄(키), en 이 읽는 문장. src=reuse 는 narration_el_en.js 의 영어 녹음 그대로, trim 은 from 줄의 영어 녹음을 같은 자리에서 자른 것, new 만 새로 녹음한다. 배역·연기 지시는 read_script_el.json 의 같은 줄을 따른다.

acts.set:<A|B1|B2>: 장면 세트(배경·소품·배우 크기). scenes[].set 으로 장면 들어갈 때 자동 호출
acts.daylight:<dusk|night>: B1 부엌의 저녁 빛 겹(0.25) / 밤(0)
acts.friend:<id>:<enter|hop|hide|strike|roll|: 친구 한 명 (enter = 문에서 걸어와 숨는 자리로, strike = 놀이판 SUCCESS 연출)
acts.cut:<bam|jara|ddong|songgot|jeolgu|myeon: 만화 컷(두 장) — 컷 속 외침(VOICE_LINES cut_*) 그대로 재사용

lines.text: 옛날 옛날, 깊은 산골에 팥죽을 아주 잘 쑤는 할멈이 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, deep in the mountains, there lived an old grandma who made the yummiest red bean porridge.
segs: Once upon a time, deep in the mountains, there lived an old grandma who made the yummiest red bean porridge.

lines.text: 팥밭에는 빨간 팥이 주렁주렁 열렸어요.
lines.en: Bright red beans hung thick all over the bean field.
segs: Bright red beans hung thick all over the bean field.

lines.text: 할멈은 호미로 콕콕 김을 매며 콧노래를 흥얼흥얼 불렀지요.
lines.en: Grandma pulled the weeds, poke, poke, with her little hoe, humming hum-hum-hum.
segs: Grandma pulled the weeds, poke, poke, with her little hoe, humming hum-hum-hum.

lines.text: 어흥! 어느 날 커다란 호랑이가 나타났어요. "할멈, 잡아먹어야겠다!"
lines.en: Roar! One day, a big tiger appeared. Grandma, I'm going to eat you up!
segs: Roar! One day, a big tiger appeared.
Grandma, I'm going to eat you up!

lines.text: 할멈은 깜짝 놀라 호미를 떨어뜨렸어요. 다리가 후들후들 떨렸지요.
lines.en: Grandma was so frightened that she dropped her hoe. Her knees were shaking like jelly.
segs: Grandma was so frightened that she dropped her hoe. Her knees were shaking like jelly.

lines.text: 할멈은 떨리는 목소리로 말했어요.
lines.en: In a trembling voice, Grandma said,
segs: In a trembling voice, Grandma said,

lines.text: "호랑이야, 동짓날에 맛있는 팥죽을 쑤어 줄게. 그때까지 기다려 다오." 호랑이는 어슬렁어슬렁 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then. The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.
segs: Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then.
The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.

lines.text: 할멈은 호랑이가 사라진 산길을 한참 바라보았어요.
lines.en: Grandma stared down the mountain path long after the tiger was gone.
segs: Grandma stared down the mountain path long after the tiger was gone.

lines.text: 드디어 동짓날이 되었어요. 할멈은 팥죽을 쑤면서 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.
lines.en: At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.
segs: At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.

lines.text: 보글보글, 구수한 팥죽 냄새가 부엌에 가득했지요.
lines.en: Bubble, bubble. The sweet, nutty smell of porridge filled the whole kitchen.
segs: Bubble, bubble. The sweet, nutty smell of porridge filled the whole kitchen.

lines.text: "오늘 밤 호랑이가 오면 나는 어떡하지."
lines.en: What will I do when the tiger comes tonight?
segs: What will I do when the tiger comes tonight?

lines.text: 그때 부엌문 밖에서 작은 소리가 들렸어요.
lines.en: Just then, a tiny sound came from outside the kitchen door.
segs: Just then, a tiny sound came from outside the kitchen door.

lines.text: 데굴데굴~ 알밤이 굴러왔어요. "할멈, 팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 알밤은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 뜨거운 아궁이 속에 쏙 숨었어요.
lines.en: Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in. Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you! Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.
segs: Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in.
Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you!
Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.

lines.text: 엉금엉금~ 자라가 기어왔어요. "나도 팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 자라는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 물독 속에 퐁당 숨었어요.
lines.en: Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.
segs: Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in.
Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too!
Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.

lines.text: 철퍼덕! 쇠똥이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 나도 도울게!" 쇠똥은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 부엌 바닥에 납작 엎드려 숨었어요.
lines.en: Splat! Cow Plop arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too!
Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.

lines.text: 콕콕! 송곳이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 송곳은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 바닥 틈에 뾰족 숨었어요.
lines.en: Poke, poke! Awl arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.

lines.text: 쿵더쿵! 절구가 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 절구는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 문 위로 올라가 숨었어요.
lines.en: Thump-a-thump! Mortar arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.

lines.text: 할멈은 친구들에게 팥죽을 듬뿍듬뿍 떠 주며 조금씩 힘이 났어요.
lines.en: Scoop, scoop! With every bowl she gave her friends, Grandma felt a little braver.
segs: Scoop, scoop! With every bowl she gave her friends, Grandma felt a little braver.

lines.text: 똑똑똑! 마당에도 친구들이 찾아왔어요.
lines.en: Knock, knock, knock! Out in the yard, more friends came to help.
segs: Knock, knock, knock! Out in the yard, more friends came to help.

lines.text: 펄럭펄럭~ 멍석이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 멍석은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 마당에 돌돌 말려 숨었어요.
lines.en: Flap, flap! Straw Mat arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Straw Mat ate the porridge, then rolled up tight in the yard to hide.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Straw Mat ate the porridge, then rolled up tight in the yard to hide.

lines.text: 성큼성큼! 지게가 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 지게는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 담벼락에 기대어 숨었어요.
lines.en: Stomp, stomp! Carrier came striding in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Carrier ate the porridge, then leaned against the garden wall to hide.
segs: Stomp, stomp! Carrier came striding in.
Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Carrier ate the porridge, then leaned against the garden wall to hide.

lines.text: 할멈은 눈물을 닦고 친구들에게 소곤소곤 속삭였어요.
lines.en: Grandma wiped her tears and whispered, psst, psst, to her friends,
segs: Grandma wiped her tears and whispered, psst, psst, to her friends,

lines.text: "얘들아, 도와줘!"
lines.from: "얘들아, 도와줘!" 친구들을 순서대로 눌러서 호랑이를 혼내 주세요!
lines.en: Friends, help me!

lines.text: "호랑이가 오면 모두 힘을 모아 주렴."
lines.en: When the tiger comes, let us all work together.
segs: When the tiger comes, let us all work together.

lines.text: 깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 어흥! 호랑이가 어슬렁어슬렁 찾아왔어요!
lines.en: It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!
segs: It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!

lines.text: "할멈, 약속대로 왔다. 팥죽을 먹고 나서 너를 잡아먹겠다!"
lines.en: Grandma, I am here, just like I promised. First the porridge, and then I will eat you up!
segs: Grandma, I am here, just like I promised. First the porridge, and then I will eat you up!

lines.text: "호랑아, 팥죽 먹기 전에 아궁이 불 좀 봐주렴." 할멈의 말에 호랑이가 아궁이 앞에 쪼그려 앉았어요.
lines.from: "호랑아, 팥죽 먹기 전에 아궁이 불 좀 봐주렴." 할멈의 말에 호랑이가 아궁이 앞에 쪼그려 앉았어요. 누가 먼저 혼내 줄까요?
lines.en: Tiger, before we eat the porridge, please watch the fire for me. At Grandma's words, the tiger squatted down by the fireplace.
segs: Tiger, before we eat the porridge, please watch the fire for me.
At Grandma's words, the tiger squatted down by the fireplace.

lines.text: 알밤이 아궁이에서 톡! 튀어나와 호랑이 눈을 딱 때렸어요!
lines.en: Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!
segs: Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!

lines.text: "앗, 뜨거워! 눈이야!" 호랑이가 눈을 씻으려고 물독에 얼굴을 쏙 넣었어요.
lines.from: "앗, 뜨거워! 눈이야!" 호랑이가 눈을 씻으려고 물독에 얼굴을 쏙 넣었어요. 다음은 누구일까요?
lines.en: Ow, hot! My eyes! The tiger dunked its face into the water jar to wash its eyes.
segs: The tiger dunked its face into the water jar to wash its eyes.

lines.text: 물독 속 자라가 호랑이 입을 앙! 물었어요!
lines.en: Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!
segs: Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!

lines.text: "아야야!" 호랑이가 깜짝 놀라 뒷걸음질을 쳤어요.
lines.from: "아야야!" 호랑이가 깜짝 놀라 뒷걸음질을 쳤어요. 다음은 누구죠?
lines.en: Yowch! The tiger jumped in surprise and stumbled backward.
segs: The tiger jumped in surprise and stumbled backward.

lines.text: 호랑이가 쇠똥을 밟고 쭈르륵~ 미끄러졌어요!
lines.en: The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!
segs: The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!

lines.text: 미끌! 호랑이가 꽈당 넘어졌어요.
lines.from: 미끌! 호랑이가 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 이번엔 누구일까요?
lines.en: Slip! The tiger went crash — flat on the floor!
segs: Slip! The tiger went crash — flat on the floor!

lines.text: 송곳이 호랑이 엉덩이를 콕! 찔렀어요!
lines.en: Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!
segs: Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!

lines.text: "엉엉, 아파!" 호랑이가 문 쪽으로 도망가요.
lines.from: "엉엉, 아파!" 호랑이가 문 쪽으로 도망가요. 다음은 누구?
lines.en: Boo-hoo, that hurts! The tiger ran away toward the door.
segs: The tiger ran away toward the door.

lines.text: 절구가 문 위에서 쿵! 호랑이 머리 위로 떨어졌어요!
lines.en: Mortar fell from above the door — thump! — right on the tiger's head!
segs: Mortar fell from above the door — thump! — right on the tiger's head!

lines.text: 호랑이는 눈앞이 빙글빙글 돌아 비틀비틀 걸었어요.
lines.en: Everything was spinning round and round, and the tiger wobbled on his feet.
segs: Everything was spinning round and round, and the tiger wobbled on his feet.

lines.text: 쿵! 절구에 맞은 호랑이가 마당으로 도망쳐 쭉 뻗어 버렸어요.
lines.from: 쿵! 절구에 맞은 호랑이가 마당으로 도망쳐 쭉 뻗어 버렸어요. 이제 누구 차례죠?
lines.en: Thump! Hit by the Mortar, the tiger ran out into the yard and stretched out flat.
segs: Thump! Hit by the Mortar, the tiger ran out into the yard and stretched out flat.

lines.text: 멍석이 호랑이를 돌돌돌 말아 버렸어요!
lines.en: Straw Mat rolled the tiger up, round and round and round!
segs: Straw Mat rolled the tiger up, round and round and round!

lines.text: 돌돌돌! 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요.
lines.from: 돌돌돌! 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 마지막은 누구일까요?
lines.en: Round and round! The tiger got rolled up tight in the Straw Mat.
segs: Round and round! The tiger got rolled up tight in the Straw Mat.

lines.text: "으악, 답답해! 꺼내 줘!"
lines.en: Help! It is so tight in here! Let me out!
segs: Help! It is so tight in here! Let me out!

lines.text: 지게가 호랑이를 번쩍 지고 가서 바다에 풍덩! 던져 버렸어요!
lines.en: Carrier hoisted the tiger up, carried the tiger off, and — splash! — tossed the tiger into the sea!
segs: Carrier hoisted the tiger up, carried the tiger off, and — splash! — tossed the tiger into the sea!

lines.text: 호랑이는 허우적허우적 헤엄쳐 멀리멀리 달아났어요. 다시는 할멈 집에 오지 않았답니다.
lines.en: The tiger paddled and splashed and swam far, far away. And he never came back to Grandma's house again.
segs: The tiger paddled and splashed and swam far, far away. And he never came back to Grandma's house again.

lines.text: 만세! 호랑이를 물리쳤어요! 할멈은 친구들과 맛있는 팥죽을 나누어 먹었답니다.
lines.en: Hooray! The tiger was beaten! Grandma shared yummy red bean porridge with all her friends.
segs: Hooray! The tiger was beaten! Grandma shared yummy red bean porridge with all her friends.

lines.text: 할멈은 마당으로 총총 나와 친구들을 꼬옥 안아 주었어요.
lines.en: Grandma hurried out, pitter-patter, and hugged her friends tight, squeeze!
segs: Grandma hurried out, pitter-patter, and hugged her friends tight, squeeze!

lines.text: "고맙다, 얘들아. 너희 덕분에 살았구나."
lines.en: Thank you, my dear friends. You saved me.
segs: Thank you, my dear friends. You saved me.

lines.text: 알밤도, 자라도, 쇠똥도, 송곳도, 절구도, 멍석도, 지게도 모두 후루룩 배불리 먹었지요.
lines.en: The chestnut, the turtle, the dung, the awl, the mortar, the mat and the carrier all went slurp, slurp, until their tummies were full.
segs: The chestnut, the turtle, the dung, the awl, the mortar, the mat and the carrier all went slurp, slurp, until their tummies were full.

lines.text: 작은 친구들이 힘을 모으면 커다란 호랑이도 물리칠 수 있답니다.
lines.en: When little friends work together, they can even send a great big tiger away.
segs: When little friends work together, they can even send a great big tiger away.
